Usage: pty root [--json]

Report the effective registry root and the native default without reading or
creating registry files or contacting a daemon.

Flags:
  --json   Emit {effective: {path, source}, nativeDefault: {path}} as JSON

Effective source: flag (--root), PTY_ROOT, PTY_SESSION_DIR, or default.
The native default is independent of --root and registry environment overrides.
Paths are returned as resolved, without canonicalization or alias folding.
This command is exempt from the socket root-length backstop so it can report
an over-long root. Other commands retain that backstop.

Plain output has two labelled lines: Effective and Native default.
PTY_SESSION_DIR deprecation notices retain their existing stderr behavior.
